🔄 App update, now in the background
- ⏬ The update keeps downloading after you close the app, switch to another one or lock the phone
- 🔁 A half download is continued where it stopped, it never starts from zero again
- 📊 Notification shows percent, downloaded / total size and speed while it runs

- 🧹 After the new version is installed the downloaded APK is deleted, so it does not eat storage
